standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the presheaf Hom-set into a sheaf Hom-set, giving the second formula.

core_obligations: Establish the presheaf adjunction: the Hom-set of presheaves from F to u^p G is naturally the Hom-set from g_{p!}F to G, bifunctorially (proof lines 1833 onwards, the first formula).

Derive the sheaf-theoretic formula from the presheaf one by identifying Hom_Ab(F, g^{-1}G) with Hom_PAb(g_{p!}F, G) and then with Hom_Ab(g_!F, G), using the universal property of sheafification (proof lines 1834-1843).
Conclude the bifunctoriality of both displayed formulas, completing the proof up to line 1872.
proof_roadmap: Compute the presheaf-level adjunction from the definitions.
Transfer it to sheaves through the universal property of sheafification.
difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes that the presheaf-theoretic pushforward g_{p!} is left adjoint to u^p and that the sheaf-theoretic g_! is left adjoint to g^{-1}, exhibiting the two bijection formulas. The sheaf-theoretic formula is derived formally from the presheaf one: for abelian sheaves the Hom-set into g^{-1}G is identified with Hom-sets of presheaves into G, and then with Hom-sets out of g_!F by the universal property of sheafification (proof lines 2833-2872 region, i.e. lines 1833-1872). The presheaf-theoretic adjunction itself is a direct computation from the definitions of u^p and g_{p!}. H2: the two-step derivation through the universal property of sheafification is the substance and is written out.
